maya: heads-up — bringing up pegasus21b (quant int8) on canary today. initial runs show intermittent OOMs when concurrent batches hit >3 and some long prefill traces.
ashwin: can you paste the failure log? is it frag or simple alloc OOM?
maya: alloc fails with kv cache allocation error, plus a lot of small free/alloc churn in dmesg. looks like fragmentation. stack shows: `kv_cache_alloc -> gpu_malloc -> oom`.
ashwin: ok fragmentation makes sense for int8 layout. what are the default batch + max_new_tokens we're using?
maya: default scheduler: `batch_size=3, max_new_tokens=256, prefill_window=1024, aggressive_prefetch=true`.
tom: interesting — pegasus21b seems to amplify KV pressure because attention heads * sequence dims are larger than smaller models. propose: lower aggressive_prefetch, add prefill decay, and gate bursts.
jess: can we try `aggressive_prefetch=false` + `prefill_window=512` and bump `max_new_tokens` cap to 512 for user API but clamp per-request on runtime if memory is low?
linh: that gating idea is good. runtime can enforce `if (free_mem < X) clamp(max_new_tokens, 128)` for this model profile.
maya: ran a quick canary with `aggressive_prefetch=false` and `prefill_window=512` — no OOMs in 2h and p95 latency increased ~8ms, throughput unchanged. memory fragmentation dropped (heap scatter down 35%).
deploy-bot: deploy canary: pegasus21b/int8 -> recipe v0.4.3 deployed to 4 nodes.
ashwin: we should add a KV trim heuristic: after reply generation if free_mem < threshold, run `kv_trim(age_threshold=2)` to free stale segments — helps long-conversation churn.
tom: also add a warmup path: for int8, pre-load first layer weights lazily then fill rest when idle. reduces peak concurrent allocs on bursty traffic.
jess: on the eval side — summarization BLEU/ROUGE dropped ~1.2 pts vs int16 for a small subset. need regression run across the 500-case eval suite before wide rollout.
maya: planned: run full eval + two canary configs (A: no prefetch; B: prefetch with kv_trim) and collect cost/latency/quality for 24h. I'll tag results here.
linh: add a note to model catalog to set model-level default `max_new_tokens=512` but runtime clamp to 256 for low-memory machines. config snippet for catalog:
```
{
  "model": "pegasus21b",
  "quant": "int8",
  "defaults": {
    "max_new_tokens": "512",
    "prefill_window": "512",
    "aggressive_prefetch": "false",
    "kv_trim_threshold_mb": "300"
  }
}
```
ashwin: sounds good. once evals land, if quality drop >1.5 pts we fallback to int16 for production and keep int8 for cost experiments.
jess: thanks — please include the eval tag `eval/pegasus21b/2026-03-20` when you upload results.
maya: will do. I'll post the 24h report here and open a follow-up thread for rollout plan. :thumbsup:
